title: Basic Boards
description: Ya got the stuff? We're gonna start off simple, just some wooden templates. These'll let ya craft an item once before being used up. Ta make em, you're gonna wanna take a log and place it on the stone anvil, then [right click it with a knife in hand](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/template_making.png:256:148). A dagger can work, too, but knives are more consistent in my opinion. You should get yourself about 6 or so boards. I sugges' ya get a few more. Jus' repeat the process.
